metadata.question: Does the chlorophyll concentration in the equatorial Pacific Ocean (around 140 degrees West) decrease in December 1999 compared to August 1998 ?

data.raw_code: The question asks about chlorophyll concentration in the equatorial Pacific Ocean (around 140°W) comparing December 1999 vs August 1998. Analysis: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Equatorial Pacific around 140°W → Point at (0, -140) or small region - Time: Specific months - August 1998 and December 1999 - Data: Ocean color/satellite-derived chlorophyll data - Best dataset: SeaWiFS (1997-2010) or MODIS Ocean Color - We'll use SeaWiFS Level-3 data (NASA/OCEANDATA/SeaWiFS/L3SMI) which has 'chlor_a' band 2. Masking strategy: - Ocean color data already processed - We'll mask land using a water mask - No cloud masking needed for ocean color (clouds already handled in L3) 3. Logic: - Get monthly composites for each time period - Calculate mean chlorophyll concentration in region - Compare: If Dec 1999 < Aug 1998 → A (Yes), else B (No) - Handle missing data cases Important considerations: - SeaWiFS data available from 1997 onward - Use small region around point to avoid land - Check if collections have data for both periods - Calculate valid pixel counts ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-140, 0]); // 140°W, Equator const region = point.buffer(100000); // 100km buffer for ocean region // Time periods const aug1998 = ee.DateRange('1998-08-01', '1998-08-31'); const dec1999 = ee.DateRange('1999-12-01', '1999-12-31'); // 2. Data Acquisition - SeaWiFS Level-3 Ocean Color const seawifs = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/SeaWiFS/L3SMI') .select('chlor_a'); // Chlorophyll concentration // Filter for August 1998 const aug1998Col = seawifs.filterDate(aug1998); const aug1998Size = aug1998Col.size().getInfo(); // Filter for December 1999 const dec1999Col = seawifs.filterDate(dec1999); const dec1999Size = dec1999Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 1998 Images: ${aug1998Size}`); console.log(`December 1999 Images: ${dec1999Size}`); // Check C1: Empty Collection if (aug1998Size === 0 || dec1999Size === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create monthly composites const aug1998Img = aug1998Col.mean(); const dec1999Img = dec1999Col.mean(); // 3. Processing - Count valid pixels const augCount = aug1998Img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); const decCount = dec1999Img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`August 1998 Valid Pixels: ${augCount}`); console.log(`December 1999 Valid Pixels: ${decCount}`); // Check C2: No Valid Pixels if (augCount === 0 || decCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Mean chlorophyll values const augMean = aug1998Img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); const decMean = dec1999Img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`August 1998 Mean Chl: ${augMean?.toFixed(4)} mg/m³`); console.log(`December 1999 Mean Chl: ${decMean?.toFixed(4)} mg/m³`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer // Check C3: Calculation Failure if (augMean === null || decMean === null || isNaN(augMean) || isNaN(decMean) || augMean < 0 || decMean < 0 || // Chlorophyll can't be negative augMean > 30 || decMean > 30) { // Unrealistically high chlorophyll console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare values: Decrease means Dec 1999 < Aug 1998 if (decMean < augMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
